rows.en: ＊Mechanic＊＠１１０＿００１Hm? What, you need something?＝＠１１０＿００２The lights in here keep￥flickering, so I'm checking￥the wiring.
＊Mechanic＊＠１１０＿００３Talking to me breaks my focus,￥so could you keep quiet?
Um, who are you?
You're a shady one.
Um, who are you?
What a shady person!
＊Mechanic＊＠１１０＿００４Huh? Me? Can't you tell?￥I'm the great Rei, the mechanic￥around here!
＊Rei＊＠１１０＿００５There. If that's all, get going.
＊Mechanic＊＠１１０＿００６What'd you say?
＊Mechanic＊＠１１０＿００７Shady?! I've been working here￥as a mechanic for five years!!＝＠１１０＿００８You don't know the great Rei?￥You must be new around here!
＊Mechanic＊＠１１０＿００９Geez, you're getting in my way!!
＊Rei＊＠１１０＿０１０Hm...?＝＠１１０＿０１１Come to think of it, I don't see￥clothes like yours much.
＊Rei＊＠１１０＿０１２You look like some kind of￥student or somethin'.
＊Rei＊＠１１０＿０１３Hmm, wait a sec...￥Are you one of those candidates?
Yes, more or less.
You only just noticed?
Yes, more or less.
You only just noticed?
＊Rei＊＠１１０＿０１４Ah, figured.＝＠１１０＿０１５Thing is, you candidates are all￥wound up tight, every last one￥of you, right?
＊Rei＊＠１１０＿０１６I can't stand that kinda thing.＝＠１１０＿０１７We work our butts off￥maintaining this place, and you￥guys don't even notice!
＊Rei＊＠１１０＿０１８A candidate, huh? No wonder I￥got a bad vibe.＝＠１１０＿０１９Shouldn't you be too busy to￥stand around chatting with me?＝＠１１０＿０２０You people are always in such￥a hurry.
＊Rei＊＠１１０＿０２１Just watching it wears me out.＝＠１１０＿０２２You're a candidate too, right?￥Doesn't it tire you out?
Sure, it's tiring.
But it can't be helped.
Yes, it's tiring.
But it can't be helped.
＊Rei＊＠１１０＿０２３Yeah, figures. Training every￥single day, right?＝＠１１０＿０２４Candidate or not,￥tired is tired.
＊Rei＊＠１１０＿０２５That's why you're too tired to￥notice the stuff we fixed up!
＊Rei＊＠１１０＿０２６Whoa, how noble of you. No way￥I could ever pull that off.＝＠１１０＿０２７Not that I'd want to.
＊Rei＊＠１１０＿０２８Go on, get to your training.￥I'm still on the clock here!
＊Rei＊＠１１１＿００１Ah! Crap...￥I was in the middle of a job.＝＠１１１＿００２Only meant to take a breather...
＊Rei＊＠１１１＿００３You showin' up made me totally￥forget about my work.
So you were slacking.
Hey, it's not my fault.
So you were slacking.
Hey, it's not my fault.
＊Rei＊＠１１１＿００４Sh-shut up! You're distracting￥me! What if I mess up the￥wiring?
＊Rei＊＠１１１＿００５Yeah, yeah, I know!￥It's not your fault!!＝＠１１１＿００６Anyway, you'll make me screw up,￥so quit butting in!
＊Rei＊＠１１１＿００７Today's just not my day.＝＠１１１＿００８Nothin' but pointless jobs...￥Then I run into a candidate,￥of all people... What a mess...
Did I do anything wrong?
Isn't that a bit harsh?
Did I do anything wrong?
Isn't that a bit harsh?
＊Rei＊＠１１１＿００９It ain't like that.＝＠１１１＿０１０It's just, candidates come off￥as a bunch of stiffs, so they've￥got a bad rep.
＊Rei＊＠１１１＿０１１Whoa, close one. Almost cut the￥wrong wire.
＊Rei＊＠１１１＿０１２Yeah? Sorry. Those stiff-necked￥candidates just tick me off.
＊Rei＊＠１１１＿０１３Whoa! Close one...￥Almost screwed that up!＝＠１１１＿０１４I always mess up when I talk￥and work at the same time.＝＠１１１＿０１５Don't you have stuff to do too?￥Get going already!
＊Rei＊＠１１１＿０１６There we go.￥Perfect.＝＠１１１＿０１７Boring job, though...
＊Rei＊＠１１１＿０１８Well, nobody can complain￥after all that.
Thanks for your work.
Sounds like tough work.
Thanks for your work.
Sounds like tough work.
＊Rei＊＠１１１＿０１９You bet!＝＠１１１＿０２０Man, I'm beat!￥Time for a break.
＊Rei＊＠１１１＿０２１Whoa! You get it!!￥A job like this, even you could￥pull off, no problem.
＊Rei＊＠１１１＿０２２Say, didn't you come here￥to train?＝＠１１１＿０２３Did you forget? Eh, whatever.
＊Rei＊＠１１１＿０２４Hey, if you find anything busted￥in the facilities from now on,￥don't call me over little stuff!
＊Rei＊＠１１１＿０２５Unless it's a "real emergency,"￥I ain't takin' the job! See ya!
